_comment: Known failures of the synthetic products in the knx-sim flash-then-plan loop (test_sim_catalog_loop_synthetic_catalogue): application id to the step that fails first, with the open issue. A product here is the evidence of a bussard bug; the fix removes its entry. A listed product that fails at another step fails the test.

M-00FA_A-2820-10-0000.reason: syn-s7-lsm5-0705: bussard sends the product's LdCtrlTaskSegment on LSM 5 to object 5 by PID 5 on 0705, where ETS sends no LSM 5 record (capture, #489); knx-sim refuses it (T_NAK), so the flash fails (#680)
